capsuleName.description:
The name of the capsule (mask) represented by this result.
This field typically matches the {@link ReliabilityCapsuleTimedDataQuery#maskName} provided in the query.

timeRanges.description: The list of time ranges during which the capsule (mask) is active (`1`).

title:
Represents the result returned by the execution of a {@link ReliabilityCapsuleTimedDataQuery#execute}.

This type contains the name of the capsule (mask) and the list of time ranges
during which the mask is active (e.g., periods to be excluded from analysis).
name: ReliabilityCapsuleTimedDataResult
